author: filcentury20
quote: It's not just a remake; it's a true labour of love, crafted for all Zelda fans (and even those who aren't). It preserves the soul of the original 1998 game while refining it into an even more perfect masterpiece. This is a fantastic opportunity for anyone who has never experienced Ocarina of Time to finally do so, while those who played it before can relive the nostalgia of the 90s.Ocarina of Time Remake is a must-play for gamers of all ages, featuring stunning art direction, a timeless remastered soundtrack, a touching story, and unforgettable characters! Without a doubt, the GOTY of 2026!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: filcentury20
quote: GTA being GTA. Better graphics, worse missions. While it continues to leave its mark on entertainment, Rockstar chose to keep fans waiting for thirteen years, only to deliver a hyper-detailed game that lacks a compelling main storyline. Glitches and bizarre physics are easily encountered throughout the game, particularly during the first half.
